Company

# Engineering the systems that infrastructure runs on.

Founded by technology entrepreneurs delivering exceptional engineering for telecom providers, financial institutions and engineering firms — from ideation to large-scale deployment.

Vision

“To transform operational effectiveness and customer satisfaction through cutting-edge automation, AI-powered insights and cohesive management — and become the premier supplier of groundbreaking technology that lets businesses attain excellence.”

Objective

## AI, applied to real operations.

We harness AI, machine learning and cloud to deliver strategic, business-focused solutions that enhance customer experience and ensure operational excellence — turning IT initiatives into success stories.

4+

Years building for mission-critical infrastructure

**5** Core focus areas

**2** Continents — India & United States

Milestones

More than four years transforming the digital realm — from engaging web and mobile experiences to enterprise-grade platforms.

Founded

#### A skilled group of technology entrepreneurs set out to bring exceptional engineering to telecom, finance and engineering firms.

2021

#### Built adaptable cloud platforms for network rollouts — the foundation of the Fiber Rollout SaaS solution.

Platform era

#### Shipped productized platforms: program management, GIS digital twin, quality inspection and rollout command.

Applied AI

#### Brought agentic AI and computer vision into the field — from research to production-grade deployment.

Today

#### Operating across India and the United States, serving mission-critical infrastructure.

#### AI / ML

Applied AI — agentic systems, computer vision and forecasting — moved from research into production.

Coordinate operations on scalable cloud foundations engineered for high availability.

Legal / Privacy

# Privacy Policy

Last updated June 2026

Neo Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (“Neotecx”, “we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect and how we use it. This is placeholder copy intended for your legal team to review before launch.

## Information we collect

When you contact us or request a demo, we collect the details you provide — such as your name, company, work email and message. We may also collect basic, anonymized analytics about how the site is used.

## How we use it

- To respond to your enquiries and arrange demos.
- To improve our products, content and website.
- To meet our legal and security obligations.

## Sharing

We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers who help us operate, and where required by law.

## Your rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by emailing [sales@neotecx.com](mailto:sales@neotecx.com).

## Contact

Questions about this policy? Email [sales@neotecx.com](mailto:sales@neotecx.com).
